title: Data Engineer | Initech Careers
text:
Data Engineer



Initech is hiring a Data Engineer to build batch and streaming pipelines.

Responsibilities
- Build ETL pipelines with Airflow and dbt
- Model data in Snowflake
- Work with analysts on reporting

Requirements
- 3+ years with SQL and Python
- Experience with Kafka is a plus

This role is hybrid in Austin, TX, with two office days a week. Remote candidates in Texas may be considered.
